If automatic browser/profile detection keeps failing, adding a cookie file yourself is the most reliable option.

1. From your browser's web store, install the 'Get cookies.txt LOCALLY' (or 'cookies.txt') extension.
2. Go to www.youtube.com and make sure you are signed in.
3. Click the extension icon and press 'Export' to save the cookie file. Unless you choose otherwise, it is usually saved to your Downloads folder.
4. Come back to this settings screen and press 'Search again'. The file you saved will appear in the 'Detected cookie file' list. Select it and you're done.

If problems persist, please send the app.log file from the folder opened by 'Open log folder' below.
